ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.claim: The command is addressed to the infernal guards: seize him, put a collar on his neck, then roast him in the great Fire.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.anchor: خذوه: أي يقال للزبانية خذوه فغلوه: أي اجعلوا في عنقه غلا، ثم الجحيم صلوه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r2.claim: He reads the fronted Fire as exclusive: they are to roast him only in the greatest Fire because he had lorded over people.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r2.anchor: قال الزمخشري: ثم لا تصلوه إلا الجحيم، وهي النار العظمى، لأنه كان سلطانا يتعظم على الناس

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r3.claim: He rejects the exclusivity inferred from fronting as neither Sibawayh's nor expert grammarians' doctrine, and calls Ibn Zayd's kingly-status explanation weak; Ibn Abbas's proof-reading fits all the damned, not kings alone.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r3.anchor: وإنما قدره لا تصلوه إلا الجحيم، لأنه يزعم أن تقديم المفعول يدل على الحصر

RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r9.speaker: المبرد
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r9.claim: Al-Mubarrad says aṣlaytuhu means to expose or bring someone to the fire; ṣallaytuhu is another form, like akramtuhu and karramtuhu.
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r9.anchor: قال المبرد : أصليته النار إذا أوردته إياها وصليته أيضا كما يقال : أكرمته وكرمته

RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r10.claim: The command consigns him to al-Jahim, the great fire, fitting his former arrogance as a ruler.
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r10.anchor: وقوله : { ثم الجحيم صلوه } معناه لا تصلوه إلى الجحيم ، وهي النار العظمى لأنه كان سلطانا يتعظم على الناس

STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.speaker: Q, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.claim: The commands to seize and cast the person into Hell are addressed to the angels who govern Hell.
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.anchor: These verses are a command to the angels who govern Hell (Q, Ṭ)

TABATABAI:69:27-36/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r6.claim: They are to put him into the tremendous Fire and make him remain bound to it.
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r6.anchor: أي أدخلوه النار العظيمة وألزموه إياها

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r3.claim: Fronting al-jahim restricts the burning: admit and burn him only in the great Fire, fitting punishment for his arrogance.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r3.anchor: دل التقديم على التخصيص والمعنى لا تصلوه أي لا تدخلوه إلا الجحيم

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r4.speaker: سعدى المفتي
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r4.claim: Saʿdi al-Mufti infers that the restriction applies specifically to the arrogant, because the condemned man had exalted himself over people.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r4.anchor: قال سعدى المفتي فيكون مخصوصا بالمتعظمين وفيه بحث

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.claim: The repeated ثم marks increasing terror among binding, roasting, and chain punishment, not elapsed time; the scene's threat requires no pause between torments.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.anchor: ثم الدلالة على تفاوت ما بين العذابين الغل وتسلية الجحيم

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.speaker: ابن الشيخ
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.claim: Ibn al-Shaykh avoids coordinating both ثم and ف on one clause by positing omitted successive commands to the wardens; ثم links the commands, while ف signals immediate execution.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.anchor: قال ابن الشيخ إن كلمتي ثم والقاء إن كانتا لعطف جملة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r10.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r10.claim: Al-Kalbi glosses ṣallūhu as “put him into it.”
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r10.anchor: فذلك قوله: {خذوه فغلوه (30) ثم الجحيم صلوه (31)} قال الكلبي: أدخلوه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r11.speaker: المبرد
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r11.claim: Al-Mubarrad says both aṣlaytuhu and ṣallaytuhu mean that one sends someone into the Fire, just as one can say akramtuhu or karramtuhu.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r11.anchor: يقال: أصليته النار، إذا أوردته إياها

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r3.claim: “Ṣallūhu” means put him into the Fire.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r3.anchor: { ثم الجحيم صلوه } أدخلوه. { ثم في سلسلة ذرعها سبعون ذراعا فاسلكوه }

QASHANI:69:25/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:69:25/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:69:25/r4.claim: The next punishment is deprivation's inferno and suffering through an unending chain of events and varied torments.
QASHANI:69:25/r4.anchor: ثم } جحيم الحرمان ونيران الآلام { صلوه

ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.claim: These are God's commands to the keepers of Hell, phrased as an implied utterance as though addressed to the useless wealth and power mentioned by the condemned man.
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.anchor: Bu emirler taraf-ı ilâhîden zebânilere emirdir. O kimsenin ağzından o işe yaramayan mal ve sultana söyleniyormuş gibi hikâye suretinde mukadder kavl ile ifade olunmuştur.

ELMALILI:69:30-34/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r4.speaker: author
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r4.claim: Jahīm is a violently surging great fire, the most severe layer of Hell.

ELMALILI:69:30-34/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r5.claim: Putting Jahīm first restricts the destination: he is consigned to Jahīm alone, nowhere else.
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r5.anchor: Burada “cahîm”in takdîmi kasr içindir, yani başka yere değil, ancak cahîme

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.claim: After the left-handed person's account, God orders the angels to bind his hands to his neck, take him to hell, and bind him to the criminals' long chain.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.anchor: Allah Tealâ görevli meleklere o günahkârın ellerini boynuna bağlayıp cehenneme götürmelerini, sonra da suçlulara ait uzun zincirdeki yerine bağlanmalarını emreder

BURHAN:v1p77/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p77/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p77/r3.claim: A balanced cadence can be followed by a longer second clause, as in ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوى, or by a longer third clause, as in the command to take and bind the condemned man.

BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.claim: The order “then the Fire, roast him” preserves the verse endings; saying “roast him in the Fire” would convey the meaning but lose their joined cadence.
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.anchor: ولو قال صلوه الجحيم لأفاد المعنى ولكن يفوت الجمع

BURHAN:v3p274#2/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r2.speaker: بعضهم
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r2.claim: Some also explain the unusual order as giving the Fire particular emphasis or exclusivity.

BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.claim: Verse-ending alignment can motivate multiple instances of fronting; when reasons conflict, the strongest governs, and when equal the speaker may choose either order.
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.anchor: قد يكون في كل واحد مما ذكرنا من الأمثلة سببان فأكثر للتقديم فإما أن يعتقد إعادة الكل أو يرجح بعضها

NAHHAS:v5p21/r20.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p21/r20.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p21/r20.claim: The wāw may be retained as original; deletion is explained by the weak boundary between wāw and following hāʾ.
NAHHAS:v5p21/r20.anchor: ويجوز إثبات الواو على الأصل وممن حذفها فلسكون الواو والهاء ليست بحاجز حصين

SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r2.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r2.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī says fronting الجحيم restricts the destination: send him only to Hell.
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r2.anchor: قال الزمخشري: " ثم لا تصلوه إلا الجحيم "

SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r3.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r3.claim: The commentator says this restriction is not the doctrine of Sībawayh or leading grammarians; the author says grammar does not rule out al-Zamakhsharī's analysis.
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r3.anchor: قال الشيخ: " وليس ما قاله مذهبا لسيبويه ولا لحذاق النحاة "

ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r2.claim: After shackling him, the command is to make him enter hell.
ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r2.anchor: and then let him enter hell

ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r1.claim: The command means to roast him only in al-Jaḥīm, the immense, fiercely blazing fire, for his grave sin of disbelief in God.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r1.anchor: أي لا تصلوه إلا الجحيم وهي النار العظيمة الشديدة التأجج لعظم ما أوتي به من المعصية وهي الكفر بالله تعالى العظيم

ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r2.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r2.claim: Another view says he was sent there because he exalted himself over people, taking the context as a ruler’s punishment; Al-Ālūsī answers that this may describe only one subset of left-handed people.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r2.anchor: وقيل حيث كان يتعظم على الناس وهو مبني على اختصاص ما قبل بالسلاطين بقرينة تعظيم أمره وتنصيص الله تعالى على تعذيبه

ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r3.claim: Qatāda’s report does not rule out the ruler reading: this passage may describe some left-handed people, just as 107:3 describes a subset.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r3.anchor: وأجيب عما يخدشه مما يفهم من كلام قتادة بأنه لا ضير في كونه بيانا لحال بعض من أوتي كتابه بشماله

ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r4.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r4.claim: Some authorities say al-Jaḥīm is the name of one particular level of Hell.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#5/r4.anchor: وأيضا قد ذكروا أن الجحيم اسم لطبقة من النار

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r13.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r13.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r13.claim: Ṣallūhu means to make him enter the blazing Hell.

BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r3.claim: They are to roast him only in the greatest fire, fitting because he exalted himself over people.
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r3.anchor: وهي النار العظمى لأنه كان يتعظم على الناس

BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r5.claim: Putting the Fire and then the chain first signals particularity and draws attention to the kinds of torment; thumma marks their differing severity.
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r5.anchor: وتقديم ال { سلسلة } كتقديم { الجحيم } للدلالة على التخصيص والاهتمام بذكر أنواع ما يعذب به

BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r6.claim: “Then” marks the elevated severity of the punishment; al-jaḥīm is the immense fire that overwhelms anyone who sees it.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r6.anchor: معظما رتبة عقابه في الشدة والهول بالتعبير بأداة التراخي : { ثم الجحيم } أي النار العظمى

BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r7.claim: “Roast him” commands repeated, intense immersion in the fire, like roasting a sheep again and again.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r7.anchor: بالغوا في تصليته إياها وكرروها لغمسه في النار كالشاة المصلية مرة بعد أخرى

BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r8.claim: The greatest fire suits a man who tried as hard as he could to burn advisers’ hearts with his words and who exalted himself over the weak.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r8.anchor: لأنه كان لا يألو جهدا أن يحرق قلوب النصحاء بأشد ما يقدر عليه من الكلام وغيره , وكان يتعظم على الضعفاء

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r7.claim: The first thumma marks a higher rank of punishment: entering the Fire is harsher than seizure and shackling.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r7.anchor: للتراخي الرتبي لأن مضمون الجملة المعطوفة بها أشد في العقاب من أخذه ووضعه في الأغلال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r8.claim: Ṣallā the Fire means to suffer its burning or warm oneself by it; when made transitive it takes the forms aṣlāhu nāran or ṣallāhu nāran.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r8.anchor: مضاعف تضعيف تعدية لأن صلي النار معناه أصابه حرقها أو تدفأ بها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r11.claim: Fronting “Hell” and “in a chain” hastens the hearer’s distress and maintains the rhyme.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r11.anchor: على عامله لتعجيل المساءة مع الرعاية على الفاصلة وكذلك تقديم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#3/r1.claim: The command is to put him into the Fire.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#3/r1.anchor: ثم الجحيم صلوه أي أدخلوه النار

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#3/r2.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#3/r2.claim: Al-Zajjāj glosses it as making him enter the Fire.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.claim: God orders the keepers to seize him forcibly from the gathering, shackle his neck, and take him to Hell to be immersed in it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.anchor: أي: يأمر الزبانية أن تأخذه عنفا من المحشر، فتغله، أي: تضع الأغلال في عنقه، ثم تورده إلى جهنم فتصليه إياها،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p216/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p216/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p216/r1.claim: The command means to immerse the condemned man in Hell.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p216/r1.anchor: ثم الجحيم صلوه} أي: اغمروه فيها.

JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r1.claim: Al-jaḥīm is a name for Hell and a great fire; al-jaḥīm, al-saʿīr, and al-waqūd are near-synonyms.
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r1.anchor: الجحيم: اسم من أسماء جهنم، وهو في اللغة: اسم للنار العظيمة، والجحيم والسعير والوقود نظائر.

JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r2.claim: Taṣliya means making someone stay in the fire; its root also describes warming oneself and following a predecessor closely.
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r2.anchor: والتصلية: إلزام النار، ومنه: اصطلاء القعود عند النار للدفاء، وأصل الباب: اللزوم،

JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.claim: After describing two groups through their books, the passage warns of punishment prepared for sinners.
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.anchor: لما تقدم ذكر حالتي الناس في الكتاب عقبه بذكر وعيد العصاة، وما أعد لهم،

JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r9.claim: The command is to put him into the fire and make him remain there.
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r9.anchor: ثم الجحيم صلوه أي: أدخلوه النار وألزموه إياها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r1.claim: Roast him only in the greatest Fire, fitting for a ruler who exalted himself over people.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r1.anchor: ثم لا تصلوه إلا الجحيم ، وهي النار العظمى ، لأنه كان سلطانا يتعظم على الناس

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r2.claim: صلى النار and صلاة النار are expressions for putting someone into the Fire.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.claim: Repeated ثم marks the escalation between shackling, roasting, and threading him through the chain, not elapsed time.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.anchor: الدلالة على تفاوت ما بين الغل والتصلية بالجحيم ، وما بينها وبين السلك في السلسلة ، لا على تراخي المدة

MUQATIL:69:25-32/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:69:25-32/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:69:25-32/r7.claim: They are to roast him in Hell's sixth gate.
MUQATIL:69:25-32/r7.anchor: { ثم الجحيم صلوه } [آية: 31] يعني الباب السادس من جهنم فصلوه

NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r1.claim: “Roast him in the Inferno” means put him into the greatest Fire.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r1.anchor: أى ادخلوه يعنى لا ثم تصلوه إلا الجحيم وهى النار العظمى

NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r2.claim: Alternatively, “الجحيم” is accusative under an implied verb explained by “صلوه”.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#7/r2.anchor: أو نصب الجحيم بفعل يفسره صلوه

QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r6.claim: Thumma al-jaḥīma ṣallūhu means make him suffer in the blazing Hellfire.
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r6.anchor: { ثم الجحيم صلوه } أي اجعلوه يصلى الجحيم
